subject: Annualized collection window waiver request – VentureBridge
messages:
From: Rebecca Chen <r.chen@venturebridge.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: VentureBridge Finance <payables@venturebridge.io>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: collection window waiver for 2028 fiscal cadence

Hi Logan,

We're getting close to finalizing terms internally and have one last ask from our FP&A team. VentureBridge runs an annualized collections cadence and they want invoices on a quarterly schedule with a 120-day collection window (effectively Net-120) rather than standard Net-30/Net-60. The rationale is to align Redwood billing to our quarterly revenue recognition windows so we can centralize cash forecasting.

High-level:
- Contract length: 18 months (preferred)
- ARR committed: ~$1.2M
- Request: Quarterly invoicing with Net-120 on each quarter invoice, or alternatively milestone invoices at 90/120 days

I attached our proposed payment schedule for reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept this cadence and what approvals/conditions would apply? If Net-120 is not possible, please advise alternatives (early-pay discounts, partial prepay).

Thanks,
Rebecca Chen
Head of Strategic Finance
VentureBridge

[Attachment: venturebridge_payment_schedule.pdf (PDF)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Chen <r.chen@venturebridge.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: collection window waiver for 2028 fiscal cadence

Rebecca — thanks for the clear note and the schedule. Looping in the internal team to assess approvals and exceptions.

Marissa / Aditya / Rishi / Priya — quick ask: VentureBridge (DB-4721) is asking for quarterly invoicing with Net-120 collection terms tied to each quarter invoice. Context: 18‑month commitment, ~$1.2M ARR. Please advise:
- Commercial recommendation (discounts, guardrails)
- Finance: what credit controls or escrow requirements needed for Net-120?
- Legal: any contractual language we should require (payment triggers, late fee ramp, termination for non-payment)

I'll coordinate back to Rebecca once we have a path.

—Logan
Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: collection window waiver for 2028 fiscal cadence

Logan — thanks for the ping. Quick commercial thoughts:
- We can offer Net-120 on a conditional basis for an 18‑month committed contract with a 5% early-pay discount if VentureBridge pays within Net-45 for the first two quarters (demonstrates good payment behavior).
- If they decline the discount, require 20% prepayment on signing to reduce upfront exposure, then quarterly invoices Net-120 for the remainder.
- Recommend we keep standard SLA credits intact but add a clause allowing suspension of service on missed payment after 45 days past invoice (gives us operational leverage).

I'll draft the proposed concession language for Legal to review.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Adding ops/contract notes:
- If Finance approves Net-120, Sales Ops will add a receivables milestone and set up an invoice schedule in our billing system with automated reminders at T+30/60/90 to the customer and internal collection owner.
- Need an exec approval for non-standard payment term (Net-120) as it exceeds current Authorized Exceptions (Net-90). Please escalate to Deal Desk Lead / CFO.

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: collection window waiver for 2028 fiscal cadence

Reviewed from Finance side. Key points and conditional approval:
- We can approve Net-120 for DB-4721 under the following conditions:
  1) 20% prepayment at signing (applied to first invoice).
  2) Automated credit hold policy after 45 days late; suspension authority to CS/product ops on written notice.
  3) Escrow-style ACH mandate for quarters 3 and onward OR corporate guarantee from parent company (if available).
  4) Finance will require monthly AR reconciliation and a dedicated collections owner on the VentureBridge side.
- Revenue recognition impact is understood; legal needs to add payment triggers and late fee schedule.

Numbers: ARR ~1.2M; requested concession increases DSO risk materially but manageable with the above controls. This approval is specific to Deal DB-4721 and expires if signature not received within 30 days.

Approved (conditional): R.Malhotra, Finance

Subject: Approved: Conditional Net-120 quarterly invoicing for VentureBridge (DB-4721)

Rebecca — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: Finance has approved a conditional Net-120 quarterly invoicing cadence for VentureBridge under the controls below. Please confirm acceptance of the conditions so we can finalize contract language and send DocuSign.

Approved conditions (summary):
- 20% prepayment at signing (applied against first quarter invoice).
- 18‑month committed term at the agreed ARR (~$1.2M).
- 5% early-pay discount if VentureBridge pays any quarterly invoice within Net-45 for the first two quarters (optional concession).
- Automated credit hold after 45 days past invoice; service suspension permitted thereafter.
- Escrow-style ACH mandate OR corporate guarantee for quarters 3+; customer to provide banking mandate prior to second invoice.
- Approval is specific to Deal DB-4721 and expires if the agreement is not fully executed within 30 days.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will send the concession language to Priya for legal redline.
2) Aditya will populate the DocuSign packet and billing milestones.
3) Rebecca to confirm acceptance of the above or propose alternative security (corporate guarantee).

Rebecca — please reply to confirm and we'll route the DocuSign packet once Priya has applied the legal clauses.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
